description: Centres de secours secondaires extérieur (Cantal) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Secondary emergency centres at the outer limits of the Cantal. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map Viewing Service (WMS) of the dataset: External secondary emergency centres (Cantal)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.1.1, WMS 1.3.0. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2019-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
